heroIntro: I’m Mohamad Moukayed, an engineering student building across robotics, embedded systems, electronics, and software. I enjoy practical problems where hardware and software have to work together.
featuredSummary: A custom 3D printer designed to extrude chocolate, built around NEMA stepper motors, a Raspberry Pi 5, and Klipper firmware.
featuredDescription: The project brings together a motion platform, stepper motor control, and printer firmware to turn chocolate into a printable material. The machine is controlled by a Raspberry Pi 5 running Klipper.
competitionDescription: Won first place at the NYUAD Hack My Robot competition as part of team 0hmSec.
